web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: The official manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) rose to 50.1 in September, ending two straight months of contraction, according to a Reuters poll. The private RatingDog Manufacturing PMI compiled by S&P Global is also expected to edge up to 51.6 from 51.5 in August. The non-manufacturing PMI also returned to expansionary territory, climbing to 50.2, as business activity picked up in the services sector.
